title: osf review: multi-agent PR review pipeline
summary: Adds a full pull-request review subsystem to osf: a lens catalogue (20 shipped lenses plus repo/org overrides), a reviewer roster driven by the coding agents in `agents.rs`, a clean-copy workspace so a PR cannot configure its own reviewer, quote verification of every finding against the real files, a deterministic reducer that turns answers into a verdict, and a two-phase `review run` / `review reduce` split so each reviewer job holds only its own provider key while the final job alone mints the code-host token. A new `review.yml` workflow wires this into CI with per-job egress allow-lists and a fork-review gate.

lanes.label: CI / Workflow
lanes.subtitle: GitHub Actions
lanes.summary: The new review workflow and the existing CI scan job. Jobs are split so no single job holds both a provider key and the code-host token.

lanes.label: osf CLI
lanes.subtitle: crates/osf
lanes.summary: The osf binary: new `review run`, `review reduce`, `agents list` and `hooks install --agents` commands, plus the lens, reviewer, quote and reducer modules behind them.

lanes.label: Reviewer agents
lanes.subtitle: external coding agents
lanes.summary: The coding-agent CLIs osf drives headless as reviewers: codex, claude, opencode and omp. Each runs in a fresh home with only its own login and credential.

lanes.label: Trusted config & data
lanes.subtitle: base branch, lenses, journal
lanes.summary: The base-branch tree that supplies lenses, prompt and `[review]` settings, plus the journal and SARIF artifacts the run leaves behind.

nodes.label: review.yml
nodes.subtitle: pull_request_target
nodes.summary: Builds osf from the base branch with no secrets, fans out one job per reviewer, then a final job that collects saved answers, decides and posts. Fork PRs run only when OSF_REVIEW_FORKS is set.

nodes.label: CI scan job
nodes.subtitle: osf scan --no-suppress
nodes.summary: The existing CI scan now passes --no-suppress so a PR cannot hide findings behind an osf-disable marker.

nodes.label: moon review task
nodes.subtitle: osf review run --if-enabled --warn-only
nodes.summary: A pre-push moon task that runs the review locally with --warn-only, since the builder's own workspace exit code is never trusted to gate.

nodes.label: osf review run
nodes.subtitle: review_run::run / run_reviewer
nodes.summary: Selects lenses for the change, runs each roster reviewer over every lens in a clean copy, and either journals and decides or saves one reviewer's run to a file.

nodes.label: osf review reduce
nodes.subtitle: review_run::reduce_saved
nodes.summary: Reads the saved reviewer files, revalidates each answer, checks findings against the files, journals every answer and the decision, writes SARIF and posts.

nodes.label: Lens catalogue
nodes.subtitle: lenses::load / select
nodes.summary: Loads 20 shipped lenses, then org and repo `.osf/review-lenses/*.toml`, and selects the ones a change earns by tier, path trigger or signal.

nodes.label: Reviewer roster
nodes.subtitle: reviewers::roster / run_one
nodes.summary: Turns the `[agents]` selection into reviewers, runs one headless with a fresh home, read-only switches and only its own credential, and validates its answer.

nodes.label: Agent registry
nodes.subtitle: agents::AGENTS / resolve
nodes.summary: The one list of agents osf can drive, now carrying family, command, hook wiring, read-only mode, schema flag and login paths, plus the `[agents]` selection resolver.

nodes.label: Quote verifier
nodes.subtitle: quotes::check
nodes.summary: Checks every finding's quote against the real file and line, with whitespace collapsing, line tolerance and path containment, and is the only way to build a VerifiedAnswer.

nodes.label: Reducer
nodes.subtitle: reducer::decide_lens / decide
nodes.summary: Turns verified answers into a per-lens verdict by quorum, blockers and mean-of-means, then a weighted whole-review verdict against the threshold.

nodes.label: Clean copy
nodes.subtitle: clean_copy::CleanCopy
nodes.summary: Copies the change's tracked and untracked files into a temp folder, leaving out every agent's project settings and every symlink, so a PR cannot configure its reviewer.

nodes.label: Review context
nodes.subtitle: review_context::build / ChangeFolder
nodes.summary: Assembles the prompt metadata, writes the diff and log into a read-only folder, and redacts secrets through the scan rules before any reviewer sees them.

nodes.label: Answer schema
nodes.subtitle: answer::extract_and_validate
nodes.summary: The JSON Schema every reviewer answer must match, plus fenced-block extraction and the lens/criteria checks the schema cannot express.

nodes.label: Builder family detect
nodes.subtitle: builder::detect
nodes.summary: Reads each commit's Code-Generator trailer to name the families that built the change, so a reviewer from the builder's own family sits the change out.

nodes.label: Changeset signals
nodes.subtitle: changeset_risk::signals_for
nodes.summary: Adds content-based signals (public surface, concurrency, new-file, repeated-logic, high-traffic path) that lens triggers match against, read from the diff rather than paths.

nodes.label: Suppression engine
nodes.subtitle: osf-lint-core::apply_suppressions
nodes.summary: Now takes owned_rules so a marker naming only another checker's rule is neither suppressing nor reported unused, and a marker with no reason no longer suppresses.

nodes.label: codex
nodes.subtitle: codex exec --sandbox read-only
nodes.summary: Runs with --output-schema and CODEX_API_KEY, in a read-only sandbox, ignoring user config and rules.

nodes.label: claude
nodes.subtitle: claude --print --output-format json
nodes.summary: Runs restricted to Read/Grep/Glob with an inline --json-schema, and its answer sits under the envelope's structured_output field.

nodes.label: opencode
nodes.subtitle: opencode run --format json
nodes.summary: Runs with --pure and OPENCODE_PERMISSION denying edits and bash, using OPENROUTER_API_KEY.

nodes.label: omp
nodes.subtitle: omp --tools read,grep,glob
nodes.summary: Runs with project extensions, skills and rules disabled, limited to read/search tools.

nodes.label: Base branch tree
nodes.subtitle: /base, read-only
nodes.summary: The trusted configuration root: lenses, prompt file and `[review]` settings are read from here, never from the PR, so a PR cannot weaken its own review.

nodes.label: PR head tree
nodes.subtitle: /pr, read-only data
nodes.summary: The pull request's own checkout, mounted read-only and treated purely as data by every reviewer job.

nodes.label: Journal
nodes.subtitle: ReviewAnswer / ReviewDecision
nodes.summary: Append-only event log now carrying review answers and the decision, with transcript paths dropped from the replay hash.

nodes.label: SARIF & saved runs
nodes.subtitle: review-run-*, review-findings
nodes.summary: Per-reviewer saved answer files uploaded as artifacts, and the final SARIF findings artifact the reduce job writes.

edges.label: builds base osf, runs per reviewer
edges.summary: The workflow builds osf from the base branch and runs one reviewer job per provider, each with only its own key.

edges.label: collects saved runs, posts
edges.summary: The final job downloads every saved reviewer run, mints the verifier token and runs reduce to decide and post.
A run builds its roster from the trusted config and drives each reviewer.
The run selects the lenses the change earns before starting any reviewer.
Each reviewer starts in a clean copy of the change with no agent settings.
The run builds the prompt metadata and the read-only diff folder through review_context.
The run detects builder families so a reviewer from the builder's own family is left out.
Reduce checks every saved finding's quote against the files before scoring.
Reduce turns the verified answers into per-lens and whole-review verdicts.
Every saved answer is revalidated against the schema and its lens before scoring.
The roster is built from the agent registry's review entries and the `[agents]` selection.

edges.label: codex exec
edges.summary: The roster starts codex headless with its schema flag and read-only sandbox.

edges.label: claude --print
edges.summary: The roster starts claude restricted to file tools with an inline schema.

edges.label: opencode run
edges.summary: The roster starts opencode with its permission config denying edits and bash.

edges.label: omp
edges.summary: The roster starts omp limited to read, grep and glob tools.
Lenses are loaded from the trusted config root, so a PR cannot edit its own lens.
The PR tree is read as data for the diff and changed-file list, never executed.
Every answer and the decision are appended to the journal.
Kept findings are written as SARIF and the saved runs are uploaded as artifacts.
Content-based signals the change earns are matched against each lens's trigger signals.
The scan job runs with --no-suppress, and the engine now tracks rule ownership so a marker cannot silently cover another checker's rule.
The pre-push moon task runs the review locally with --warn-only.

flows.title: One reviewer job: run and save
flows.summary: A single reviewer job builds the prompt from trusted config, runs its agent in a clean copy, validates the answer and saves it for the reduce job.

flows.title: Reduce: verify, decide, post
flows.summary: The final job collects every saved reviewer run, revalidates and quote-checks each finding, decides the verdict, journals it and posts to the pull request.

views.title: Review system containers
views.summary: The new review pipeline: the workflow fans out per-reviewer jobs, osf drives each agent in a clean copy, and the reduce job verifies, decides and posts.

views.title: Reviewer run internals
views.summary: Inside one reviewer run: roster, clean copy, prompt context, agent process and answer validation.

views.title: Reduce internals
views.summary: Inside reduce: saved runs are bound to reviewers, answers revalidated, findings quote-checked, then scored and journaled.
